event_summary: A lit flame on the end of a thin rod moves to the lower side of a black balloon, after which the balloon suddenly breaks apart and disappears from its original position.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with an intact glossy black spherical balloon on the left side of a wood-grain table and a black circular base on the right with a thin light-colored rod attached on top. A small yellow-orange flame is visible at the free end of the rod. The rod and flame move in an arc from the lower right toward the balloon. The flame reaches the lower side of the balloon and overlaps that surface. Immediately afterward the flame is no longer visible, the balloon suddenly loses its spherical form, and dark pieces fly away from the balloon's previous position. The black base and attached rod remain on the table afterward, with the rod extended toward the left.

reasons: The intact black spherical balloon is clearly visible on the left.
The black circular base and attached rod are visible on the right.
A small flame is visible near the rod's free end.
